scope: Independent recomputation from saved validation predictions only. No model execution, fitting, optimization or test data access.
interpretation: Metrics average future0.1..h*0.1s, excluding anchor; endpoint metrics are separately labeled.
Teacher is causal observed-history reconstruction, not autonomous prediction.
Stopping uses10-frame windows: true RMS speed>.1*fit_train_std and predicted RMS<.1*true RMS. Natural rest is excluded.
B energy decrease is expected. Compare future physical-energy error and change error; drift alone is not a conservation-failure metric.
Each damping uses the same64 groups; multi has384 records, not384 independent initial groups.
b=1 teacher angle MAE may fail the predefined0.1rad diagnostic gate; its decoded physics is less reliable than aggregate readout quality suggests.
A10k andA20k use separately train-calibrated readouts for their respective encoders; A20k andbothB use identical frozen readout bytes.
These are validation-only, single-seed results; no unseen damping or test generalization is established.
